The Mazda6 is the first Mazda to offer available Bose® Centerpoint® 2 in its 11-speaker premium audio system. Available
Centerpoint® 2 enables listeners to enjoy a surround sound experience from nearly any stereo source, such as CDs, MP3
devices and radio broadcasts, including available SiriusXM® Satellite Radio.* It has been specifically engineered to meet
the unique demands of reproducing surround sound in a vehicle. Unlike conventional synthesized surround sound systems that
compare left and right channel information to create a virtual surround experience, Centerpoint® 2 technology uses frequency
content in addition to the left and right stereo information to create a more lifelike surround experience. Get ready to hear music
that matches the emotions you’ll feel while driving.
/ Sound Tune-up /
Even in a car as quiet as the Mazda6,
unwanted ambient noise can interfere with your
enjoyment of music. Bose® AudioPilot® noise
compensation technology constantly detects
and distinguishes between music and unwanted
ambient noise via an in-cabin microphone.
Then proprietary digital signal processing
tuned specifically for the Mazda6 automatically
adjusts your music for optimal listening.
*Not equipped for XM Radio reception. SiriusXM Satellite Radio reception requires a subscription and Mazda satellite radio. See full disclaimer in Specifications.
